subject: Source-type correction and illustrative reference-price calculation for Evernorth's Cantor ELOC; contingent capacity is not actual capital

repository_context.note: SEC filing was inspected as rendered HTML. This artifact does not claim byte-complete source capture or an independently anchored retrieval time.

source_registry.source_type: SEC Form S-1 registration statement; preliminary prospectus subject to completion

source_type_correction.corrected_source_type: SEC Form S-1 registration statement; preliminary prospectus subject to completion
source_type_correction.evidence: The filing cover identifies Form S-1 and states the preliminary prospectus is subject to completion.

prior_76800000_field.correct_interpretation: Rounded illustrative gross value at the October 29, 2026 Class A closing price of $14.71, not a fixed contractual dollar cap and not actual proceeds.

per_purchase_limits: Cantor and affiliates may not exceed 4.99% beneficial ownership of outstanding Pubco Class A common stock.
Purchases are capped at 20% of trading volume during the applicable purchase period.
Purchases are also capped by Pubco's good-faith share estimate in each purchase notice.
verified_eloc_contract_terms.previous_day_price_threshold: Previous trading-day closing price must be at least the greater of $1.00, 90% of that closing price and any higher threshold specified by Pubco.
verified_eloc_contract_terms.commencement_conditions: Purchase obligations commence only after the ELOC Registration Statement is declared effective, a final prospectus is filed and the agreement's further conditions are satisfied.
verified_eloc_contract_terms.fee_due: Within five business days after the date the ELOC Registration Statement is declared effective.

caveats: The $14.71 figure is the October 29 closing price disclosed on the prospectus cover, not necessarily the applicable VWAP during a future purchase period.
Actual purchase price is 97% of the applicable VWAP, subject to the block-trade pricing exception.
The issuer may choose not to sell any shares and remains subject to commencement, threshold, volume and beneficial-ownership conditions.
The $74.467M amount is illustrative purchase proceeds before the upfront fee and other expenses; it is not net proceeds.
The $73.946M amount subtracts only the upfront fee under an assumption that it is paid; payment has not been verified.
The prospectus states zero proceeds received under the ELOC as of its date.

resale_registration.exception: Company may receive proceeds from cash exercise of Sponsor Warrants; those are separate from ELOC proceeds.

historical_cash_xrp_purchase.cash_received_note: The $214,049,995 exact subscription receipt is shown as $214.05M in the prospectus summary. This cash-received amount is distinct from cash_used_usd, whose append-only correction overlay sets purchase cost to $214,000,000.

convertible_notes.stated_use: General corporate purposes, including possible XRP acquisition.

company_facility_with_ripple.do_not_assume: Do not describe this as $9.7M of new Evernorth equity or as a confirmed XRP purchase.

competing_interpretations.hypothesis: At the disclosed October 29 closing price, the maximum share count implies about $76.77M nominal value and about $74.47M at 97%.
competing_interpretations.counterevidence: The actual contract uses applicable VWAP on a future purchase period; the issuer controls timing and amount; no proceeds were received as of the prospectus.

competing_interpretations.hypothesis: The ELOC has a fixed $76.8M contractual dollar cap.
competing_interpretations.counterevidence: The contract specifies up to 5,218,935 shares and a variable price formula, not a fixed USD cap.

competing_interpretations.hypothesis: The 73,688,162 registered resale shares provide cash to Evernorth.
competing_interpretations.counterevidence: The prospectus states the company receives no proceeds from selling-securityholder resales, except separate Sponsor Warrant exercise proceeds.

red_team_objections: Do not report the $76.77M reference-price scenario as a contractual dollar cap or actual proceeds.
Do not call $74.47M net proceeds; it is a 97%-of-reference-price scenario before the fee and other expenses.
Do not mark the $521,893.50 fee as paid; payment is not verified.
Do not treat the 73,688,162 resale shares as company capital.
Do not treat Sponsor Warrant exercise capacity as actual proceeds without verified cash exercises.
Do not treat the $30M notes or $9.7M Company Facility borrowing as equity or as confirmed XRP purchases.
Do not add in-kind XRP contributions to cash proceeds.
Do not treat the 2025 cash-funded XRP purchase as a November 2026 spot-market flow.

reasons: SEC source was inspected as rendered HTML without a byte-complete raw receipt.
The ELOC is contingent, issuer-discretionary financing; zero proceeds were reported as of the prospectus.
The reference-price arithmetic is a scenario, not a point-in-time market-flow feature.
Actual fee payment, ELOC purchase notices, share issuance and settlement require subsequent filings.

forecast.reason: Corporate financing capacity and historical XRP purchases do not establish a validated directional XRP signal.

next_actions: Verify the effective date and final prospectus for the ELOC Registration Statement.
Verify whether the $521,893.50 fee was paid; do not infer payment from contractual accrual.
Monitor subsequent filings for actual ELOC purchase notices, share issuance and settled proceeds.
Monitor actual XRP purchases funded by the October 2026 convertible notes.
Verify repayment status of the $9.7M Company Facility borrowing.
Keep resale registrations, warrant exercise capacity, ELOC capacity, debt, cash, historical XRP purchases and in-kind contributions separate.
